links.outcome: Normalization accuracy (mean shortest SNOMED path length) of retrieval-grounded versus ungrounded LLM strategies
links.effect: RAGnorm was most effective on every dataset: mean shortest path length 0.21 (oncology), 0.58 (sampled), 0.90 (top terms). Micro F1 88.01 on TAC2017 task 4, surpassing all other models.
links.quote: We found that RAGnorm was the most effective throughout each dataset, achieving a mean shortest path length of 0.21 for the domain-specific dataset, 0.58 for the sampled dataset, and 0.90 for the top terms dataset.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests clinical text normalization strategies using LLMs and compares zero-shot/prompted generation against retrieval-augmented generation (RAGnorm) across institutional EHR datasets and benchmark datasets.
